$description: M2 Lab design tokens, version 2 (8 September 2026). Single source of values. Edited by hand, rarely. Everything else is built from here: node tokens/build/build-tokens.mjs. Colour values are hex strings (2024 draft form) by decision, see orchestration/LOG.md.

paper.$description: Primary surface. Covers, carousels, documents, avatar

ink.$description: Text on Paper. Dark surface for Reel covers and plates

signal.$description: The mark, KEEP, lit data on Ink. Never text. Never on Paper except inside the mark

oxide.$description: KILL, broken, risk. Nothing else. On Ink only as a 4 px outline or larger

blueprint.$description: Diagrams, leader lines, arrows, second chart series, structural fills. Paper surfaces only. Darkened 8 Sep (was #1E4A80, Misha: more focused and contrast)

graphite.$description: Secondary text and labels on Paper. On Ink only for muted grid lines

primary.$description: Default surface. Paper-first is the decision that moves us off the dark-plus-one-accent cluster

dark.$description: Reel covers, caption plates, Verdict Card on video

plate.$description: Plate under text placed over video or photo

secondary-on-dark.$description: Secondary text and labels on Ink. Graphite on Ink is 2.9:1 and fails text

data.$description: Only on Ink and only on data or the mark

structure.$description: Diagram lines, arrows, process boxes on Paper only. On Ink diagrams are drawn in Paper lines

on-dark.$description: Lines and leader lines on Ink. Graphite on Ink fails the 3:1 graphic threshold

on-dark-muted.$description: De-emphasised grid lines on Ink only, never for meaning

display.$description: Hooks, cover titles, slide titles, big words in stickers. Chosen 8 Sep 2026 for its match to the mark's geometry (research/heading-font.md). Latin only. Weight 900

mono.$description: Format tags, numbers, verdict chips. Covers Cyrillic

display.$description: Hooks and titles in Saira SemiCondensed Black

size.$description: Sizes at a 1080 px wide canvas. Same values on 1080x1920 and 1080x1350; the 4:5 canvas caps the hook at 6 words instead of shrinking it (research/type-metrics.md)

default.$description: 6 to 8 words, 20 characters per line maximum

fallback-4x5.$description: Manual escape hatch on 1080x1350 only, when a hook cannot be cut to 6 words

default.$description: Carousel slide titles and statements, lower-third names. Display family for titles, text family SemiBold for statements
Burned-in subtitles, Plex Sans SemiBold, 2 lines. 14.4 CSS px on a 390 px phone, the floor is 14
Format tags, chips. 13 CSS px on a phone; 32 px fell below the 12 px floor

measure.$description: Lint constants: maximum characters per line, measured against the 888 px text column

safe.$description: Instagram UI. Zone A numbers are Meta's official ad safe zone (14 % top, 35 % bottom, 6 % sides) on 1080x1920, accessed 8 Sep 2026. Zone B is secondary consensus for organic Reels. Full model in social/zones.json

organic-bottom.$description: Zone B lower limit, secondary source

grid-crop-top.$description: 9:16 cover shown as a 3:4 grid tile keeps y 240 to 1660, derived

right-rail-top.$description: The action-button column starts here on 1080x1920, secondary source

grid-crop-side.$description: 1:1 shown as 3:4 tile loses 135 px per side, derived
4:5 shown as 3:4 tile loses 33.5 px per side, derived

circle-inset.$description: Avatar and highlight covers: 10 % of the 1080 circle diameter, derived; Meta publishes no inset

frame.$description: Layout paddings per canvas. Vertical paddings on 9:16 are the Zone A edges rounded up to the 8 px grid

pad-x.$description: Left and right. Text column 888 px

pad-bottom-reel.$description: Was 320. Meta covers 672. Subtitles may go below this in Zone B

indent.$description: Text sits 24 px right of its guide, never flush (Misha, 4 Sep)

space.$description: 8 px base. Only these steps exist

emphasis.$description: KILL outline, grid rule under the hook

chip.$description: KEEP / KILL / TEST chips. Plex Mono is monospaced, so the three labels are identical in width

width.$description: Label 36 px (109 px wide) plus 24 px padding each side, rounded to the grid

verdict.$description: Shape first, colour second. 8 % of men cannot separate red and green

fill.$description: On Paper. On Ink the fill is Signal and the label is Ink

min-width-color.$description: Below this only the monochrome mark

clearspace.$description: Share of the mark's height, all sides

size-reel.$description: Mark on a 1080x1920 cover, bottom-right of Zone A (was 120 in v1; reel-cover-v2 uses 96)

motion.$description: Motion exists to point at evidence. Values from rules/motion.md

instant.$description: Captions, claim bar text swap, hard cuts

hold.$description: Minimum dwell before any element may change

isotype-step.$description: One glyph per step when counting

default.$description: Linear. An instrument moves at a constant rate

banned.$description: Values the system does not have. The linter fails on any other value
